warRiskPremium.note: PREMIUM AT 'WORST CASE SCENARIO': CNBC Jul 18: Maritime risk CEO says oil tankers face 'worst case scenario' in Hormuz as Iran steps up attacks. War risk premiums sustained at 8-15x level. Major escalation: Two US service members killed in Jordan, Iran formally calls off interim peace agreement (MoU suspended). Trump declares peace deal over ~10 days ago. 50 killed in US strikes in July. Iraq and Syria agree to restore oil pipeline as alternative to Hormuz. Lack of diplomatic off-ramp means premiums unlikely to ease. Updated 2026-07-19
warRiskPremium.note_zh: 保费维持'最坏情形'：CNBC 7月18日报道海事风险CEO称油轮面临'最坏情形'，伊朗加大攻击。战争险保费维持8-15倍水平。重大升级：两名美军士兵在约旦阵亡，伊朗正式叫停临时和平协议（谅解备忘录暂停）。特朗普约10天前宣布和约作废。7月美军打击已造成50人死亡。伊拉克和叙利亚同意恢复输油管道作为霍尔木兹替代路线。缺乏外交出路意味着保费短期内难以回落。更新于 2026-07-19

straitThroughput.note: STRAIT REMAINS CLOSED — DIPLOMATIC OFF-RAMP GONE. Jul 13-17: US strikes on Iran continue. Jul 17: Two US service members killed in Jordan, one missing — worst US casualty event in this escalation. Jul 18: Iran formally calls off interim peace agreement (MoU suspended). Mojtaba Khamenei warns US of 'unforgettable lessons'. CNBC reports oil tankers face 'worst case scenario'. ~50 killed in US strikes in July. Iraq and Syria agree to restore oil pipeline as alternative to Hormuz — potential structural bypass. Throughput remains effectively zero for commercial traffic. Diplomatic path fully closed. Updated 2026-07-19
straitThroughput.note_zh: 海峡持续关闭——外交出路完全消失。7月13-17日：美军持续打击伊朗。7月17日：两名美军士兵在约旦阵亡，一人失踪——本次升级中最严重的美军伤亡事件。7月18日：伊朗正式叫停临时和平协议（谅解备忘录暂停）。穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊警告美国将付出'难忘的代价'。CNBC报道油轮面临'最坏情形'。7月美军打击约造成50人死亡。伊拉克和叙利亚同意恢复输油管道作为霍尔木兹替代路线——潜在的结构性绕行。商业通行量实际为零。外交途径完全关闭。更新于 2026-07-19

irgcStatementFreq.note_zh: IRGC声明频率维持在危机水平。7月17-18日：重大升级——穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊警告美国将付出'难忘的代价'。伊朗正式叫停临时和平协议（谅解备忘录暂停）。最高领袖称特朗普签名'一文不值'，称霸凌是美国外交政策核心。两名美军在约旦阵亡。7月美军打击已造成50+人死亡。IRGC言辞达到最高升级水平。更新于 2026-07-19

fleetPosition.note: ESCALATION WITH CASUALTIES: Jul 17: Two US service members killed in Jordan, one missing — worst US casualty event. Jul 18: Iran calls off interim peace deal (MoU suspended). ~50 killed in total in US strikes since Jul 7. CENTCOM posture remains aggressive with continuous strike operations. US strikes ongoing as tit-for-tat cycle intensifies. No diplomatic off-ramp visible. Iraq-Syria pipeline alternative announced as Gulf states hedge. Updated 2026-07-19
fleetPosition.note_zh: 出现伤亡的升级：7月17日：两名美军士兵在约旦阵亡，一人失踪——美军在本轮升级中最严重伤亡。7月18日：伊朗叫停临时和平协议。自7月7日以来美军打击共造成约50人死亡。CENTCOM姿态持续激进，打击行动持续。报复循环加剧。无外交出路可见。伊拉克-叙利亚管道替代方案公布——海湾国家开始对冲。更新于 2026-07-19

saudiUaeStance.threshold_zh: 自行其是 = 同盟裂痕
saudiUaeStance.note: GCC HEDGING: CRITICAL NEW DEVELOPMENT — Iraq and Syria agree to restore oil pipeline as alternative to Hormuz (CNBC, Jul 18). This is a structural bypass of the Strait. Iran calls off interim MoU. Oman's fee plan permanently moot. MBS stayed in Saudi throughout crisis. Saudi faces direct security threat. OPEC+ in turmoil. Iraq-Syria pipeline deal signals regional hedging against Hormuz dependence. China role in Hormuz post-crisis emerging. Updated 2026-07-19
saudiUaeStance.note_zh: GCC对冲中：关键新发展——伊拉克和叙利亚同意恢复输油管道作为霍尔木兹替代路线（CNBC，7月18日）。这是对海峡的结构性绕行。伊朗叫停临时谅解备忘录。阿曼通行费方案永久失效。MBS全程留守沙特。沙特面临直接安全威胁。OPEC+混乱。伊拉克-叙利亚管道协议表明地区对冲霍尔木兹依赖。中国在霍尔木兹危机后角色正在浮现。更新于 2026-07-19
